policy.rule: A replacement is not complete until the superseded runtime path is removed after parity, canary and rollback gates pass.

items.currentBehavior: Multiple mounted UI components independently request /api/exchanges/aster on short intervals.
items.replacement: One shared realtime Aster state store with a single reconciliation reader and event-driven subscribers.
items.removeAfter: Shared-state canary passes for all active users
items.keepAsFallbackUntil: At least one stable production observation window

items.currentBehavior: Active Trades can refresh account/position truth separately from the canonical account snapshot.
items.replacement: Canonical snapshot write-through plus realtime price updates; no UX polling slowdown.
removalGates: no increase in Aster REST errors
items.removeAfter: Duplicate refresh path is no longer needed
items.keepAsFallbackUntil: Canonical snapshot freshness is proven under reconnect/restart

items.currentBehavior: Runtime watches mark price and submits the TP close only after the target is crossed.
items.replacement: Exchange-native reduce-only TP with managed cancel/replace lifecycle.
removalGates: Auto Hedge close lock is preserved
single-account canary has zero semantic drift
items.removeAfter: Native TP is proven for all supported lifecycle states
items.keepAsFallbackUntil: Native TP has a stable production observation window

items.currentBehavior: Runtime watches mark price and submits ADD_DCA only after the next DCA trigger is crossed.
items.replacement: Exactly one exchange-native next-DCA limit order, rearmed only after confirmed fill and renewed safety validation.
removalGates: shadow DCA target parity is exact
margin and leverage tier preflight is preserved
only one next DCA can exist per managed leg
confirmed fill is required before rearm
single-account canary has zero semantic drift
items.removeAfter: Native next-DCA lifecycle is proven for all supported states
items.keepAsFallbackUntil: Native DCA has a stable production observation window

items.currentBehavior: Each API instance can start a periodic scheduler thread while a Cloud Scheduler trigger path also exists; a distributed minute claim prevents duplicate full ticks but not duplicate wakeups/lease attempts.
removalGates: current Cloud Scheduler resource and cadence are proven
periodic worker execution metrics are captured
order leases and minute claim remain intact
no missed scanner/TP/DCA tick in canary

items.currentBehavior: Deployments create candidate revisions/tags and container images without a bounded retirement policy.
items.replacement: Explicit retention policy preserving current, previous and a small tested rollback set.
removalGates: no currently referenced image is selected
items.removeAfter: Retention cleanup is reviewed and approved
